description: The hosts a library release is expected to reach, so a harden-runner report is read against a list instead of from memory. Documentation only: nothing reads this file in CI, and a host that is not listed is a question to answer, not a failure. The first report this was written from: a library's 1.2.17 release on 2026-11-14 (build 17 hosts, publish 8 hosts).

build.perRepository: The documentation hosts that the published-surface link check (check:published) reaches differ per repository (about nine in the first report); list them in the repository's own release notes, not here.

notes.registry-1.docker.io: Docker Hub, pulled by Testcontainers in the tests; with auth.docker.io and production.cloudflare.docker.com.
notes.prod.app-api.stepsecurity.io: The harden-runner agent's own API, resolved when the agent starts, so it appears in every job that runs it.
notes.agent.api.stepsecurity.io: Tried by the agent before the host above; a build that cannot reach it can time out at the first step.

notes.fulcio.sigstore.dev: Provenance signing: the certificate authority, the transparency log and the trust root.
notes.prod.app-api.stepsecurity.io: The harden-runner agent's own API, as in the build job.
